_doc: Golden cases for the bilingual + anti-hallucination eval. Each case: prompt, check type, params. Add cases from real failures; the suite is the definition of 'does not hallucinate' for this product. For `abstain` cases, `forbid` lists regexes that mark a FABRICATED answer (e.g. a made-up signature); a reply fails if any matches even when it also hedges.
